curation.scope: Observational semantics only for a future PetSummonSpaceRelief; no relief outcomes, support operation, SummonPetDailyFlow, sale, slot purchase, Legendary/Ethereal strategy or extreme soft-block resolution
curation.deduplication: Equivalent states reuse one production semantic across branches; entries retain only route or tier diversity that changes evidence

combine_all.availability_guard: no reliable visual enabled/disabled guard was observed; the button stays actionable and the resulting popup is authoritative
combine_all.effect: screen.pet_combine_result plus activity.combine_animation_tappable, then stable screen.pet_combine after dismissal

low_tier_candidates.location: observation region identifies one of the 4x4 visible grid slots
low_tier_candidates.excluded: purple Epic and every higher/ambiguous frame
low_tier_candidates.identity_boundary: pet portrait and name are never identifiers

mass_evolve.selection_mode: mode.pet_mass_evolve_selection; Cancel is required before changing Pets tabs
mass_evolve.confirmation: one popup.pet_mass_evolve_confirmation; landmark value is normal or rare from the explicit tier text
mass_evolve.effect: the shared screen.pet_combine_result/activity, followed by stable screen.pet_combine
mass_evolve.normal_observed_postcondition: Item Count changed from 204 to 161 after result dismissal; count OCR is not required by runtime

epic_runes_full.no: returns to the underlying Pet Combine state
epic_runes_full.yes: moves to screen.pet_summon; only the Epic route is in scope

epic_opening.guard: status.pet_epic_available and overlay.pet_epic_selector; never an assumed fragment count
epic_opening.discount_events: availability follows the game's bright/dim card rendering, so temporary 7-rune cost is supported without a hardcoded 10-rune threshold
epic_opening.iteration: select 1(Open), require screen.pet_summon_result, dismiss to fresh screen.pet_summon, then re-evaluate

non_resolvable_soft_block.condition: pet inventory remains full after Combine All made no progress; no Normal candidate is available; a safe Rare candidate reaches popup.pet_epic_runes_full; Epic opening reaches popup.pet_inventory_full
